patternId: A unique identifier for this podcast config (e.g., 'my-podcast'). Used as the folder name when saving.
patternDisplayName: A friendly name shown in the browse list. If left empty, the config ID is used.
podcastGuid: The podcast's unique ID from its RSS feed. When set, this takes priority over feed URL matching for more reliable identification.
feedUrls: One or more RSS feed URLs that identify this podcast. The app matches incoming feeds against these URLs to find the right config.
yearGroupedEpisodes: When enabled, the main episode list in the app groups episodes by their publication year with year headers.
showEpisodeThumbnail: When enabled, each episode in the podcast's main episode list shows its thumbnail (or the podcast artwork). Disable for podcasts whose episodes share uniform artwork.
playlistId: A unique identifier for this playlist within the config (e.g., 'season-1'). Used as the filename when saving.
displayName: The name shown to users in the app. Choose something descriptive like 'Seasons' or 'Story Arcs'.
resolverType: Choose how episodes are organized into groups. Each method uses a different approach.
resolverType_seasonNumber: Groups episodes by their season number from the feed or titles. Best for podcasts that tag seasons (e.g., itunes:season) or use consistent title patterns like 'S01E01'.
resolverType_titleClassifier: Groups episodes by matching their titles against patterns you define in the Groups tab. Use when episodes follow naming conventions like 'Arc 1: ...' or 'Mystery Series: ...'.
resolverType_year: Groups episodes by their publication year. Good for long-running podcasts where yearly grouping is a natural fit.
resolverType_titleDiscovery: Finds recurring patterns in episode titles and groups by them, in the order they first appear. Useful for podcasts with titled story arcs or series.
priority: Controls the order playlists claim episodes. Lower numbers go first. If two playlists could match the same episode, the one with lower priority claims it. Playlists with filters always run before filter-less ones.
presentation: Choose how groups appear in the app. 'Collect into one playlist' shows all groups inside a single entry. 'Make each group its own playlist' creates a separate entry for each group.
episodeFilters: Rules applied before organizing episodes. Within each rule, all fields must match (AND). Across rules: include passes only when ALL rules match (AND); exclude rejects if ANY rule matches (OR).
filterTitle: A case-insensitive text pattern matched against episode titles. Use regular expression syntax for advanced matching.
filterDescription: A case-insensitive text pattern matched against episode descriptions. Use regular expression syntax for advanced matching.
showYearHeaders: When enabled, episode lists show year separators, helping users navigate long lists.
showDateRange: When enabled, each group card shows the date range of its episodes (earliest to latest).
showThumbnail: When enabled, each entry in this list shows a thumbnail. Disable to render a denser, text-only list.
userSortable: When enabled, users can flip between ascending and descending order in the app.
prependSeasonNumber: When enabled, group titles are prefixed with the season number (e.g., S13 Regular Episodes). Groups with key 0 are excluded.
groupId: A unique identifier for this group within the playlist.
groupDisplayName: The name shown to users for this group in the app.
groupPattern: A text pattern matched against episode titles. Episodes matching this pattern are assigned to this group. Leave empty to create a catch-all for unmatched episodes.
groupListSort: Change the order groups appear in. Only applies when groups are collected into one playlist.
sortField: What to sort groups by. 'Group number' uses the group key, 'Newest episode date' uses the latest episode, 'Alphabetical' sorts by name.
sortOrder: Ascending (A-Z, oldest first, lowest number first) or descending (Z-A, newest first, highest number first).
yearBinding: Controls how groups relate to year sections. 'None' shows a flat list. 'Show under its year' places each group under the year of its earliest episode. 'Show in each year it spans' repeats a group for every year it has episodes in.
titleExtractor: Generates a display name from episode data for use as group titles. Reads a value, matches a pattern, and formats the result. Not used with 'By title pattern matching' — those groups use the names you define directly.
titleExtractorSource: Which part of the episode to read: title, description, season number, or episode number.
titleExtractorPattern: A text pattern to find in the source. Use parentheses () to mark parts; reference them from the template as ${1}, ${2}, …
titleExtractorTemplate: How to format the extracted text. Use ${0} for the entire match, ${1}, ${2}, … for capture groups in parentheses. Example: '${1}. ${2}' joins two captures. Omit to use ${0}.
titleExtractorFallbackValue: A default name used when none of the extraction steps find a match.
numberingExtractor: Finds season and episode numbers in episode titles or descriptions. Supports a primary pattern and a fallback, plus the option to use feed data as a last resort.
numberingExtractorSource: Which part of the episode to read: title or description.
numberingExtractorPattern: A text pattern with parentheses () marking where the season and episode numbers appear.
numberingExtractorSeasonGroup: Which matched part contains the season number. Leave empty to skip season detection.
numberingExtractorEpisodeGroup: Which matched part contains the episode number (default: 2).
numberingExtractorFallbackSeason: Season number to assign when only the fallback pattern matches (e.g., 0 for special episodes).
numberingExtractorFallbackPattern: A backup pattern tried when the primary one doesn't match. Useful for catching special or bonus episodes.
numberingExtractorFallbackCaptureGroup: Which matched part in the fallback pattern contains the episode number (default: 1).
numberingExtractorFallbackToRss: When no pattern matches, use the episode number from the feed data instead.
episodeListSort: Default sort order for episodes within groups. When not set, episodes are ordered by published date (oldest first). Can be customized per group.
episodeSortField: What to sort episodes by. 'Published date' uses the release date, 'Episode number' uses extracted numbers, 'Title' sorts alphabetically.
episodeSortOrder: Ascending (oldest first, lowest number first) or descending (newest first, highest number first).
groupEpisodeSort: Custom episode sort for this group only. When not set, uses the playlist default.
groupTitleExtractor: Custom group name rule for this group only. Generates a display name from episode data.
groupNumberingExtractor: Custom number rule for this group only. Finds season/episode numbers in titles.
groupYearBinding: Custom year-group relationship for this group only. Controls how this group relates to year sections.
